title: Night Cream for Combination Skin: How to Choose and Apply
ex: Oily T-zone, dry cheeks? You do not need two creams. Here is what to look for and the zone method for applying one cream the right way.
rt: Night Cream for Combination Skin: How to Use | Mirc Glow
rd: Night cream for combination skin made simple: what texture and ingredients to choose, the zone method for applying it and how to adjust through the seasons.
quick: Pick a medium-weight, non-greasy cream with ingredients like aloe vera and niacinamide. Apply it to the cheeks first, then use only the leftover on your fingers for the forehead, nose and chin. Use a little less in summer and monsoon, and a little more in winter.
facts: One cream is enough for most combination skin
Apply to cheeks first, leftover on the T-zone
Niacinamide suits both oily and dry areas
